Soft, neutral daylight enters from the left, catching the grain of the wood and the pale paper in his hands while leaving the back of the shop in gentle shadow. At first his attention stays on the receipts; then he lifts his head toward an off-screen customer, his shoulders settling and his hands coming to rest flat on the counter. His gaze returns briefly toward the customer, then drifts back toward the clock, and his shoulders ease as the pause lengthens.
